title: California officials highlight AI, FireSat and predictive technologies as centerpieces in state wildfire strategy
summary: Speaking at Sacramento McClellan Airport, California Gov. Gavin Newsom tallied the many cutting-edge firefighting technologies to have been adopted since he took office.

title: Experts warn AI-driven data inferencing is outpacing state privacy protections
summary: Data-privacy experts said on a recent panel that while state privacy laws regulate what data brokers can collect and sell, those laws often do not extend to the problematic conclusions those companies can infer.

title: Cyberattack against Maine telecom disrupted municipal internet service
summary: A cyberattack against a telecommunication firm in Maine knocked out internet service for more than 20 towns along the state's midcoastal region.

title: ‘Integrated’ cyber and physical attacks concerned FIFA planners
summary: “The threat environment has changed" and the lines between physical and digital attacks have blurred, said one security expert involved in FIFA World Cup Planning.

title: North Carolina commissioner named president of National Association of Counties
summary: As the National Association of Counties' latest president, North Carolina Commissioner George Dunlap will lead an initiative aimed at improving outcomes for young people.

title: Maryland’s chief digital experience officer to leave role
summary: Marcy Jacobs, Maryland's chief digital experience officer, said she thought it was time for "a fresh perspective."

title: States review satellite BEAD locations after new broadband data changed eligibility
summary: After making more federal broadband funding open to satellite internet deployments, the  NTIA is now asking some states to review their project lists.

title: Pennsylvania launches measles data dashboard
summary: Pennsylvania's new measles dashboard features details such as total case numbers and hospitalization rates at the county level.

title: As wildfire satellites enter orbit, early adopter states prepare for new data
summary: Newly launched satellites can detect relatively small blazes, giving emergency responders earlier situational awareness during the critical first stages of an ignition.

title: Arizona’s new regional cyber center a ‘force multiplier’ for local governments, students
summary: A new regional security operations center, run from two community college locations, is the latest piece of Arizona's plan to bolster the cyber defense of under-resourced local governments and build a talent pipeline.
